title: dao_origin_signature.json: reject_fresh_cross_prefix_target uses fe80 + AddrForKey-slice IID (dead coverage)
description: Out-of-scope finding from b8i2 codereview pass 3 (kimi-k3 reviewer). test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json:884 (vector reject_fresh_cross_prefix_target) builds its link-local source as fe800000000000000ed144787022f9dc — i.e., fe80::/64 + the LOW 8 BYTES of the routable AddrForKey 0202fc2fcc3b6bef0ed144787022f9dc. That is the REJECTED derivation: spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing settles that the routable 02xx address embeds NO IID; the canonical link-local IID for that pubkey is SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] U/L-cleared = 7159bd633b2e9120. The vector's expected block already records rejection at decision_stage=identity reason=iid_mismatch, so it is self-consistent as an identity-binding NEGATIVE test, but it no longer exercises its NAMED coverage (fresh cross-prefix target) because it dies at the IID check before the prefix check. Fix: either (a) regenerate the vector with the correct SHA-512 IID in the fe80 source so it reaches the cross-prefix check, or (b) rename it to reflect that it is an iid_mismatch negative. Family: same AddrForKey-migration legacy-fixture class as the b8i2 corpus fix and the ywec sweep; distinct site (a vector file, not code).
